7_risks.risk: Store tools were built against the agents_rules repo; a gate may refuse this project's docs/kinds
7_risks.mitigation: Use only projector-recognized kinds (prd, srs, rtm, feasibility, design, atomic_function, pseudocode, test_plan, development_order, final_design, master, normal_plan, report, brainstorm); on any tool error: report verbatim, log as new ledger item, adapt doc shape (never patch the tools in-run)

7_risks.risk: XLSM parse parity (G1): mixed formula/static cells break import assumptions
7_risks.mitigation: Stage 4 spike proves the parse path early against the real workbook; reconciliation numbers gate the stage

7_risks.risk: D107 advance evidence (verdicts/tests at stages 3/8/10) may require extra records
7_risks.mitigation: Use --record-review/--record-test writers; if --advance refuses, address the named REFUSE reasons before retrying

7_risks.risk: Deletion of untracked legacy plans (.IDE_Plans/*.md are gitignored today) loses them outside git history
7_risks.mitigation: Migration verification (counts+sha256) must pass first; converted born-JSON retains the full body; F0-1 commits the new JSON world
One-stage plan-ahead only; workers draft from self-contained briefs; brainstorm+master are the durable checkpoint
